user.title: Connect to GRIT Hub
user.description: Enter the GRIT API settings. After authentication, the integration will attempt bounded, passive MQTT discovery.

confirm.title: Confirm MQTT discovery
confirm.description: Authentication succeeded. The MQTT broker {mqtt_host} and topic hub ID {mqtt_hub_id} were discovered. Continue to use these values, or review the advanced settings.

advanced.title: Advanced MQTT settings
advanced.description: Automatic discovery could not validate all required MQTT settings, or advanced review was requested. Enter overrides as needed; leaving both MQTT credential fields blank uses the provisional vendor-default read-only credentials.

data_description.mqtt_host: Hostname or address of an existing MQTT broker.
data_description.mqtt_hub_id: Hub identifier used in GRIT MQTT topics.
data_description.mqtt_username: Leave both credential fields blank to use the provisional read-only defaults, or enter an override username.
data_description.mqtt_password: Leave both credential fields blank to use the provisional read-only defaults; an override password requires an override username.
data_description.mqtt_use_tls: Enable encryption for the MQTT connection.
data_description.mqtt_verify_tls: Verify the broker certificate when TLS is enabled.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GRIT Hub
reconfigure.description: Update connection settings. Leave the API token or MQTT password blank to keep the stored secret. Clearing the MQTT username also clears its password.

data_description.token: Leave blank to retain the stored API token.
data_description.mqtt_password: Leave blank to retain the stored password when a username remains configured.
data_description.mqtt_verify_tls: Applied only when MQTT TLS is enabled.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to GRIT Hub. Check the API URL, token, network path and SSL setting.
error.invalid_base_url: Enter a valid GRIT API base URL.
error.invalid_token: Enter a GRIT API bearer token.
error.invalid_verify_ssl: Select a valid API certificate-verification setting.
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a REST scan interval from 10 to 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_mqtt_host: Enter a valid MQTT broker hostname.
error.invalid_mqtt_port: Enter an MQTT broker port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_mqtt_hub_id: Enter a valid MQTT topic hub ID.
error.mqtt_password_requires_username: An MQTT password requires an MQTT username.
error.invalid_mqtt_keepalive: Enter an MQTT keepalive from 1 to 65535 seconds.

abort.already_configured: This GRIT Hub is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The GRIT Hub configuration was updated.
